name: shotcraft-card-stack
title: 卡片成组扇展
description: Establish a collection of exactly eight real images or page slices; quantity first, diversity second.
author: WeiYihao; iPolloWork integration

upstream.adaptation: Remotion frame interpolation ported to paused HyperFrames/GSAP with original pure easing functions; absolute cues reanchored to narration. Demo skeletons replaced by real content variables and theme tokens. Not a pixel-identical native Remotion render.

ai.instructions: Establish a collection of exactly eight real images or page slices; quantity first, diversity second. Not a layout for reading eight paragraphs, comparing precise values, or illustrating a feedback loop.

events.action: Gather eight actual image slices into one stack
Open the stack into a single three-dimensional fan

useWhen: Establish a collection of exactly eight real images or page slices; quantity first, diversity second.
avoidWhen: Not a layout for reading eight paragraphs, comparing precise values, or illustrating a feedback loop.

inputRules.title: Supply a short collection heading, at most 12 Chinese characters.
inputRules.mediaUrl: Existing project-local image: eight slices in a 4-column by 2-row contact sheet. Never use skeletons as delivered content.

readingOrder: Gather eight actual image slices into one stack
Open the stack into a single three-dimensional fan

cueBindings.stack: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Gather eight actual image slices into one stack. Do not estimate from text length.
cueBindings.fan: Bind to the exact measured spoken phrase for: Open the stack into a single three-dimensional fan. Do not estimate from text length.

fallback.overflow: Split at a semantic boundary or choose a suitable recipe. Do not shrink or truncate text.
fallback.missingInput: Resolve required content and real assets; report a gap instead of using placeholder graphics.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured phrases while preserving original movement ratios and final hold. Split the scene if it does not fit.
fallback.inapplicable: Select another proven recipe; with recipes-only policy, report the library gap rather than author custom graphics.

example.narration: 这些真实片段先汇成一组，再展开为八个方向。

acceptance: Every action changes the real target and reverse seeking restores the same picture.
Use actual content, measured fonts and validated project-local media.
Preserve original movement functions, geometry and ordering; the final state remains readable.
